def max_equal_sum_split(n, d):
    # Calculate prefix sums
    prefix_sums = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n):
        prefix_sums[i + 1] = prefix_sums[i] + d[i]

    total_sum = prefix_sums[n]
    max_sum = 0

    # Use two pointers to find the optimal split
    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            sum1 = prefix_sums[i]
            sum3 = prefix_sums[n] - prefix_sums[j]
            if sum1 == sum3:
                max_sum = max(max_sum, sum1)

    return max_sum
